_comment: VoxyTube - single-container Egg with Rust service and embedded PostgreSQL
name: VoxyTube
author: Kua <https://github.com/KuaFeur>
description: YouTube WebSub notification gateway. Rust and PostgreSQL are bundled in one container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The container image already contains the Rust binary and PostgreSQL.
# No additional installation is required.
exit 0

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Internal HTTP port. Allocate this port in Pelican and expose it through HTTPS.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Database Password
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to generate and persist a random local password automatically.

variables.name: Public HTTPS Callback URL
variables.description: Public URL YouTube calls for WebSub. Must end in /websub.

variables.name: Management API Token
variables.description: Bearer token for channel management; use at least 32 random characters.

variables.name: Destination Webhook URL
variables.description: Endpoint receiving normalized video events. Leave empty to disable delivery.

variables.name: Destination Webhook Token
variables.description: Optional Bearer token sent to the destination endpoint. Visible and editable in the server startup variables.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Restore File
variables.description: Optional path to a pg_dump custom-format backup inside the persistent data volume. Restored once per filename on startup.
